# Gulf Family Travels

Visa rules on this site apply to the passport type stated on each page.
GCC residency does NOT override passport-based visa requirements.

> DIY family holiday guides for residents of Dubai, the UAE, Qatar and Saudi Arabia, flying from DXB, DOH, RUH and JED. We show the exact booking order (flights → hotel → transport → experiences), transport prices for every leg, and visa checklists for Indian, EU, UK and US passport holders. Booking yourself typically saves AED 2,000+ per person versus a Gulf travel agent (e.g. Bali: AED 4,310 DIY vs AED 6,700+ agent, per person, 5 nights).

## Guides

- [Best Family Holidays from Dubai 2026 — Picked by Budget & Visa Type](https://gulfamilytravel.com/): UAE hub (default); budget trips for Indian residents, premium trips for EU/US expats, visa-free and visa-on-arrival destinations for Indians. Prices in AED, flights from DXB.
- [Best Family Holidays from Saudi Arabia 2026 — Picked by Budget & Visa Type](https://gulfamilytravel.com/saudi-arabia): Saudi hub; same picks with prices in SAR and flight times and Skyscanner links from Riyadh (RUH) and Jeddah (JED).
- [Best Family Holidays from Qatar 2026 — Picked by Budget & Visa Type](https://gulfamilytravel.com/qatar): Qatar hub; same picks with prices in QAR and flight times and Skyscanner links from Doha (DOH).
- [Is Bali Worth It for a Family Trip from Dubai in 2026?](https://gulfamilytravel.com/bali-family-trip-from-dubai): 5-day itinerary, DIY vs agent cost table (AED), transport cheat sheet, Indian and EU/US resident checklists (incl. Saudi exit/re-entry), 7 FAQs.

## Notes

- Prices are estimates per person (AED, SAR or QAR depending on the hub; all three are USD-pegged) for a family of four sharing, and are updated when pages are modified (see dateModified).
- Visa rules are summarised for convenience; official immigration websites are authoritative.
